description.zh:
证书ID，只有**CertType**=**cas**时生效。
**CertType**=**cas**时必填，表示选择已有证书。
description.en: The ID of the certificate. This parameter is required only when **CertType** is set to **cas**. In this case, specify the ID of an existing certificate.

description.zh:
证书名称，目前只支持单个证书名称，只有**CertType**=**upload**时生效。
**CertType**=**upload**时选填，给新证书的名称。
description.en: The name of the certificate. You can specify only one name. This parameter is valid only when **CertType** is set to **upload**. In this case, you can specify a name for the new certificate.

description.zh: 证书所在地域。支持**cn-hangzhou**和**ap-southeast-1**，默认**cn-hangzhou**。国际站用户建议使用**ap-southeast-1**。
description.en: The region where the certificate is located. This parameter is valid only when you set CertType to cas. Valid values are **cn-hangzhou** and **ap-southeast-1**. The default value is **cn-hangzhou**. If you are an Alibaba Cloud international account user, set this parameter to **ap-southeast-1**.

description.zh:
证书类型。

- **upload**：上传证书。
- **cas**：证书中心证书。
description.en:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

- **upload**: A custom certificate that you upload.

- **cas**: A certificate that you purchase from Alibaba Cloud SSL Certificates Service.

description.zh: 证书所属的服务域名，需属于HTTPS加速类型。
description.en: The domain name to which the certificate belongs. The domain name must be an HTTPS-accelerated domain name.

description.zh: 私钥内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入私钥内容。
description.en: The content of the private key. Specify this parameter only when you enable the certificate.

description.zh:
HTTPS证书是否启用。

- **on**：启用。
- **off**：不启用。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the SSL certificate. Valid values:

- **on**: Enable.

- **off**: Disable.

description.zh: 安全证书内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入证书内容。
description.en: The content of the SSL certificate. Specify this parameter only when you enable the certificate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn set-dcdn-domain-ssl-certificate --domain-name example.com --cert-name yourCertName --cert-id 8089870 --cert-type upload --ssl-protocol off --ssl-pub xxx --ssl-pri y0000 --cert-region cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn SetDcdnDomainSSLCertificate --region cn-hangzhou --DomainName 'example.com' --CertId 8089870 --SSLPub xxx --CertRegion 'cn-hangzhou' --CertType upload --CertName yourCertName --SSLPri y0000 --SSLProtocol off
